runtime_uncertainties: Carriage qualification, jurisdiction, parking rather than actual temporary loading, and vehicle definition exclusions require external source dossiers and independent review.
Actual 1805.05-second continuous capture at 20 Hz with four views is a physical cost and retention risk; no original recording exists yet.
Meaning of statutory endpoints at exactly 01:00 and 06:00 and cross-window counting remains a legal review question; engineering measurements do not decide it.

evidence_review.method: Reviewed every frozen evidence inventory entry and its local accepted metadata; compared case identities and acceptance fields only. Physical equivalence and branch coverage remain unresolved.

gaps.why_existing_insufficient: The frozen accepted-recording inventory is empty; no original parking duration, time, vehicle classification, or street source is available.

witness_review.branch: Nighttime parking with another vehicle present
required_context: Establish carriage transport capability, absence of self-propulsion and absence of vehicle-definition exclusions independently of the actor name.
Establish parking rather than actual temporary loading or unloading, with civil date, time zone and episode timing.
Establish qualifying vehicle and nonmotor status independently of the actor identifier.
Establish responsible person, qualifying street, municipal jurisdiction, parking purpose and actual loading or unloading activity.
Establish street boundaries, public access, municipal jurisdiction and responsible person.
Preserve unresolved definition applicability, NRS 482.029 reference and nighttime boundary-counting questions.
Realize both vehicles' geometry and states; do not assume double parking or a curbside stationary other vehicle.
Record civil date, time zone and complete parking boundaries and duration.
Specify both vehicles' dimensions, positions, routes and states without assuming the other vehicle is parked at the curb.
witness_review.reason: Parking a qualifying carriage near another vehicle is compatible with the nighttime restriction.

requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: No accepted recording; twelve source-bound proposed episodes cover duration below/at/above, each civil-time endpoint below/at/above, nonmotor scope, and parking activity. Physical classification remains unverified.
